requirements.name: Embedded DSP in C/C++
requirements.note: Cover letter states: "I have spent more time in documents and system-level specifications than writing DSP code."

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: CV states MSc Mechanical Engineering (Kallavesi University of Technology, 2020); cover letter states "my degree is in mechanical engineering rather than electrical engineering or physics" and describes direct signal processing implementation experience as limited.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience
requirements.note: CV describes coordinating integration test campaigns across teams; no formal leadership role or title is stated.

lines.quote: It appeals to me as a place to build a career in this field.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe your experience writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ for production use on real hardware, if any?
Can you describe your experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, such as code that is tested and maintained for others to use?
Can you describe your hands-on experience with RF test-bench measurement equipment, such as network or spectrum analysers, if any?
Could you describe your educational background in relation to electrical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or a closely related field, or any equivalent competence you have developed?
